content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Surge of 502/504 responses detected at edge/gateway layer starting ~16:03 UTC. Service: redwood-api. 1m window: 5xx ~ 7.8%, P50 latency jumped 210ms -> 670ms. Paging on-call. @pagerduty engaged :rotating_light:

alex.nguyen: I'll take lead. Pulling edge logs and current autoscale state. Any direct customer reports?

sara.kim: Grafana shows a concentrated fanout to backend cluster backend-34 in us-west. A subset of pods returning read timeouts. Dash: https://grafana/redwood/ingress/errors

mike: tailing gw logs. Lots of entries like "upstream read timeout" and "connection reset by peer" from the same backend pool.

alex.nguyen: region breakdown?

sara.kim: US-WEST ~ 68% of 5xx. EU/EAST largely nominal. No recent infra deploy per deploy-bot in the last 45m.

oncall-bot: On-call transfer: alex.nguyen -> sara.kim. PD incident PD-4821 created.

alex.nguyen: Triage plan: 1) quantify impact and affected routes 2) check and toggle routing/circuit-breakers 3) scale/backoff offending backend pool 4) apply quick mitigations (timeouts, routing overrides).

mike: sample log lines:
```
[2026-03-11T16:03:10Z] proxy_id=gw-12 upstream=backend-34 status=502 msg="upstream read timeout after 15s"
[2026-03-11T16:03:11Z] proxy_id=gw-12 upstream=backend-34 status=502 msg="connection reset by peer"
```

sara.kim: hypothesis: worker saturation on backend-34 causing slow responses -> gateway-level timeouts. Possibly a burst of long-context generation or an eval job hitting that cluster.

diana: Support has 12 tickets flagged, mostly generation endpoints on dedicated capacity. Potential SLA exposure, notifying account leads now.

alex.nguyen: Fast mitigations: enable fail-fast circuit breakers, route portion of traffic to fallback pool, temporarily extend upstream read timeout to reduce transient 502s, and scale replicas. Which to prioritize?

mike: quickest is routing override + fail-fast cb. I'll push 20% of /v1/generate traffic to gw-fallback-us-west and enable the cb. Admin call:
```
POST /admin/routing/overrides
{ "route": "/v1/generate*", "fallback_pool": "gw-fallback-us-west", "weight": 0.2 }
```

alex.nguyen: do it. Also bump upstream read timeout 15s -> 30s for short window. Accept higher latency to reduce 502 churn.

sara.kim: scaling backend-34 up now via k8s: setting replicas +50%.
```
kubectl scale deployment backend-34 --replicas=12 -n prod-us-west
```

mike: routing override applied. Observability: immediate drop in 5xx in the override window.

incident-bot: Change recorded in incident timeline.

diana: Drafted customer-facing support blurb: "We are investigating elevated 502/504 responses affecting generation endpoints in US-WEST. Engineers are routing traffic and scaling affected services. Next update in ~15 minutes." Ready to send. :email:

alex.nguyen: run quick aggregation on request signatures to find heavy hitters.

sara.kim: running queries: top offenders include /v1/generate?model=llama-70b with long prompt lengths (>1024 tokens). Large embedding-style payloads also overrepresented.

mike: seems like a burst from a partner A/B test with long-context runs. I'm flipping an admission control rule to cap concurrent long-context requests per customer to 4 to limit tail-load.
```
admission.control.max_long_context_per_customer=4
```

alex.nguyen: good. Any pods OOMing?

sara.kim: no OOMs, CPU on some nodes 85-95%. Memory stable.

diana: error counts: ~13k failed requests last 10m. High burn for several partners. Notifying account managers for top affected tenants.

mike: 5xx down from ~7.8% -> ~2.3% after override + scale. P95 latency still high but trending downward.

sara.kim: I'll keep the temporary timeout increase for another 10m while we verify stability.

alex.nguyen: keep it until P95 < 400ms and 5xx < 0.5% sustained for 5m. Set watch.

incident-bot: WATCH set: revert_upstream_timeout when p95_latency < 400ms AND error_rate_5xx < 0.5% for 5m. Owner: alex.nguyen.

diana: support update sent and account reps pinged.

mike: suggested post-incident actions: admission throttles on embeddings-heavy requests, restrict long-context test jobs to off-peak windows.

alex.nguyen: agreed. Action items assigned: postmortem (sara.kim), permanent circuit-breaker + admission controls (mike), customer comms and SLA review (diana), runbook updates to include routing override steps (alex.nguyen).

sara.kim: creating postmortem doc skeleton with logs, config diffs, and timeline.

mike: current metrics: 5xx ~0.45% over last 5m, P95 360ms. Initiating controlled rollback of routing override to validate stability.

alex.nguyen: proceed carefully and monitor.

mike: rollback executed. Metrics remain stable.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Metrics returned to baseline. PD-4821 closed at 16:27 UTC. Monitoring continues.

diana: CS will file follow-up tickets for impacted customers with summary and remediation steps.

alex.nguyen: solid work. We'll schedule the postmortem and follow the action items. Reopen PD if it resurfaces. :thumbsup:
